name: RightsAvailsWindowManager
tagline: Know what you can license – by title, territory, media and window.
description: Full Power Apps code-component app for media & entertainment: acquired rights and out-licences, an avails grid, exclusivity / holdback / coverage checks, a window timeline and expiries & renewals – with demo data, low-code column mapping and Power Fx events.
features: Avails engine with 8 states per territory × media × period
Exclusivity clash and holdback breach detection
Coverage of out-licences by acquired rights
Clearance → active workflow with business rules
Bulk changes with skip list, undo, CSV export
Avails report text for Outlook / Teams
